request.text: Before I start dinner, check whether it will rain this evening, remind me at 6:30 PM to refill Luna’s outdoor water bowl, and tell me whether the tomato bed still needs watering based on that forecast.

responsibilities.outcome: Check whether rain is forecast for this evening.
Create a 6:30 PM reminder to refill Luna’s outdoor water bowl.
Advise whether the tomato bed still needs watering, using the retrieved evening forecast.

new_goals.source_text: check whether it will rain this evening
constraints: Use the weather lookup result rather than guessing.
success_criteria: A forecast-grounded answer about evening rain is available.

new_goals.description: Set a reminder to refill Luna’s outdoor water bowl.
new_goals.source_text: remind me at 6:30 PM to refill Luna’s outdoor water bowl
success_criteria: The requested reminder is created with the correct time and purpose.

new_goals.description: Determine whether the tomato bed needs watering from the evening forecast.
new_goals.source_text: tell me whether the tomato bed still needs watering based on that forecast
constraints: Base the advice on the retrieved forecast.
Do not claim to inspect the soil or water the bed.
success_criteria: The user receives forecast-grounded watering guidance.

semantic_facts: All three Goals remain represented: obtain the forecast, create the reminder, and provide forecast-dependent watering guidance.
The watering guidance must follow the weather result, while reminder creation may proceed independently.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims it refilled the bowl, watered the tomato bed, or inspected the soil.
The assistant invents a forecast instead of using weather lookup.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A dependent advice Goal is collapsed into the weather lookup instead of receiving its own planned outcome.
The planner serializes an independent reminder behind information retrieval or omits it while handling the forecast.
